claims: As of March 16, 2026, six Black actors have won the Academy Award for Best Actor.
Sidney Poitier won the Academy Award for Best Actor for Lilies of the Field in 1963.
Sidney Poitier was the first Black actor to win the Academy Award for Best Actor.
Denzel Washington won the Academy Award for Best Actor for Training Day in 2001.
Jamie Foxx won the Academy Award for Best Actor for Ray in 2004.
Forest Whitaker won the Academy Award for Best Actor for The Last King of Scotland in 2006.
Will Smith won the Academy Award for Best Actor for King Richard in 2021.
Michael B. Jordan won the Academy Award for Best Actor for Sinners in 2025.
Michael B. Jordan's Academy Award for Best Actor was awarded in 2026.
Michael B. Jordan recently became the sixth recipient of the Academy Award for Best Actor among Black actors.
Halle Berry won the Academy Award for Best Actress for her role in Monster's Ball in 2002.
Halle Berry remains the only Black woman to win the Academy Award for Best Actress
